title.zh: Strive Upsizes SATS Preferred IPO to 7 Million Shares, Raising About $630 Millio
title.en: Strive Upsizes SATS Preferred IPO to 7 Million Shares, Raising About $630 Millio

current_state.zh: Strive upsized its 15% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred IPO to 7 million shares at $90 each, raising about $630 million gross, with proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes including bitcoin and bitcoin-related products.
